description: This file defines the DeviceStatusService class which implements provisioning of device status information, including battery, thermal, storage, network, and device info, for an iOS application.

classes.name: DeviceStatusService
classes.description: A final class that provides device status information, including battery, thermal, storage, network, and device info for iOS devices.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the overall device status payload including battery, thermal, storage, network, and uptime.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns a payload with device information such as device name, model, system version, app version, build, and locale.

methods.name: batteryStatus
methods.description: Internal method that gathers battery level and state, and whether low power mode is enabled.

methods.name: thermalStatus
methods.description: Internal method that retrieves the current thermal state of the device.

methods.name: storageStatus
methods.description: Internal method that computes total, free, and used storage space.

methods.name: fallbackAppBuild
methods.description: Provides a fallback value for app build if the actual build string is empty.
